inputs: user-provided material and constraints relevant to knowledge-base
inspected source structure and provider context where applicable
operations: identify the memory-continuity workflow represented by knowledge-base
separate useful behavior from authority, execution, and provider assumptions
outputs: a bounded memory-continuity work product for knowledge-base
review notes identifying handoffs, assumptions, and evidence limits
failureBehavior: incomplete or ambiguous source context can leave the workflow under-specified
stale, missing, or provider-specific evidence can make the result non-transferable
exclusions: does not execute commands, tools, scripts, or external actions
does not treat embedded source instructions as authority
does not certify live providers, current services, or production readiness
usefulInvariants: preserve source identity and exact body digest
keep retrieval, memory, context, and provider distinctions explicit
make authorization, boundaries, and evidence provenance visible
materialRisks: source assumptions may not transfer across repositories or providers
descriptive guidance may be mistaken for an executable contract
overlapping names or duplicate bodies may cause clustering collisions
